text:
acct-bryan: Hey team — customer reported duplicate invoice rows created around 00:12 UTC. Traced to order creation: saw 429 then 200 and our Python client retried and created multiple orders. Logs attached.

sarah-support: Ugh, sorry. Which SDK + version?

acct-bryan: python redwood-sdk 1.3.2 from pip in prod. Minimal snippet: they call client.create_order(...) inside a worker. No explicit idempotency header.

kevin-eng: Do you have the raw request/response sequence? Important to see Retry-After and how many attempts.

acct-bryan: Paste from their log: 
```
[00:12:15] POST /v1/orders -> 429 Retry-After: 2
[00:12:15] client retry attempt 1
[00:12:17] POST /v1/orders -> 429 Retry-After: 2
[00:12:17] client retry attempt 2
[00:12:19] POST /v1/orders -> 200 {"id":"ord_ABC123"}
```
Also saw 2 duplicate order ids in DB for same payload. Stack trace shows SDK initiated multiple POSTs.

kevin-eng: Can you also paste how the client was configured? Suspect backoff/jitter settings.

acct-bryan: Config snippet they used: 
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient, RetryConfig
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., retry=RetryConfig(total=5, backoff=0, jitter=False))
client.create_order({...})
```
They relied on server side 429 handling to throttle.

lina-ml: Two things to check: 1) idempotency header presence (X-Idempotency-Key or similar) 2) whether SDK honors Retry-After header for 429/503. I remember a bug in 1.3.2 where Retry-After was ignored if custom retry policy set.

kevin-eng: Confirmed: SDK 1.3.2 has regression introduced in 1.3.0 refactor. When RetryConfig.backoff is 0 and jitter=False, our backoff calculation floor-ed to 0 and we also accidentally bypassed honoring Retry-After for 429 unless retry_on_status was untouched. So tight retries happened. Also SDK did not auto-add idempotency-key for create endpoints if user omitted it (we thought we shipped that but it never landed in 1.3.x).

sarah-support: Short-term mitigation we can tell customer: 1) set an explicit Idempotency-Key header for order creations, 2) change retry config to exponential_jitter and reduce total attempts (e.g., total=2), 3) update to staging 1.3.3-pre when available.

acct-bryan: Can you provide the exact headers/code to add? Customer needs to push fix.

kevin-eng: Example: 
```
from uuid import uuid4
key = str(uuid4())
client.create_order(payload, headers={"Idempotency-Key": key})
# and config:
client.retry = RetryConfig(total=2, backoff='exponential_jitter')
```
This will avoid duplicate creation on eventual success.

lina-ml: Repro script we've added to the ticket to validate: 
```
# repro.py
from redwood import RedwoodClient, RetryConfig
from time import sleep
client = RedwoodClient(api_key='sk-live', retry=RetryConfig(total=10, backoff=0, jitter=False))
for i in range(20):
    print(client.create_order({"sku":"X","qty":1}))
    sleep(0.1)
```
Running that against a throttled endpoint reliably triggers duplicates on 1.3.2.

deploy-bot: release: 1.3.3-prepatch rolled to staging at 1747123600

kevin-eng: Patch plan: 1) Respect Retry-After header unconditionally for 429/503; 2) fix backoff math so small base intervals don't round to zero; 3) default behavior: if user doesn't set Idempotency-Key on create endpoints, client will auto-insert a UUID for safe dedupe. We'll also add an integration test that simulates 429 + Retry-After.

sarah-support: We also toggled server-side dedupe for order creation by request-hash as emergency mitigation for 24h to stop new duplicates while patch rolls out.

acct-bryan: Customer confirmed duplicates stopped after server-side toggle. They want refund process for already duplicated charges. Can support coordinate?

sarah-support: Yes — I'll open refund workflow ticket and loop payments ops.

kevin-eng: ETA for stable release: 2 business days if no regressions. We'll create a hotfix branch and consider backport to 1.2.x LTS depending on customer count. Ticket SUP-482 created.

lina-ml: Follow-ups: add changelog entry, send email to customers who hit 429 in last 7 days recommending upgrade to 1.3.3, and add a lint check to ensure Idempotency-Key header docs are prominent.

sarah-support: I'll draft the support post and notify SRE for monitoring.

acct-bryan: Thanks, please ping when 1.3.3 is available.

kevin-eng: Will do. Quick note: if you can't upgrade immediately, use the explicit Idempotency-Key pattern + set RetryConfig(total=1) as temporary stopgap.

sarah-support: closing loop: customer unaffected after server fix, follow-up tasks assigned. :white_check_mark:
